title: Mechanistic investigation of 6-thio-2'-deoxyguanosine targeting telomerase in cancer
core_idea: Elucidate the molecular mechanism by which the chemotherapeutic nucleoside 6-thio-2'-deoxyguanosine (6-thio-dG) interacts with telomerase and telomeres in cancer cells, focusing on whether incorporation of 6-thio-dGTP affects telomerase-mediated synthesis versus telomerase binding, and how telomere length and telomerase status influence cellular sensitivity.
tldr: This study aims to uncover how 6-thio-dG impacts telomerase function and telomere maintenance in cancer cells, and to relate telomere length and telomerase expression to sensitivity.
